== Algebraic equations ==
{{see also|Equation}}

An [[algebraic equation]] is an equation involving only algebraic expressions in the unknowns. These are further classified by [[Degree of a polynomial|degree]].

* [[Linear equation]] &ndash; algebraic equation of degree one.
* [[Polynomial#Solving equations|Polynomial equation]] &ndash; equation in which a polynomial is set equal to another polynomial.
* [[Transcendental equation]] &ndash; equation involving a [[transcendental function]] of one of its variables.
* [[Functional equation]] &ndash; equation in which the unknowns are [[Function (mathematics)|functions]] rather than simple quantities.
* [[Differential equation]] &ndash; equation involving [[derivative]]s.
* [[Integral equation]] &ndash; equation involving [[integral]]s.
* [[Diophantine equation]] &ndash; equation where the only [[Equation solving|solutions]] of interest of the unknowns are the [[integer]] ones.

==History==

* [[History of algebra]]

==General algebra concepts==
* [[Fundamental theorem of algebra]] &ndash; states that every non-constant single-variable polynomial with complex coefficients has at least one complex root. This includes polynomials with real coefficients, since every real number is a [[complex number]] with an imaginary part equal to zero.
*[[Equation]]s – equality of two mathematical expressions
* [[Linear equation]] &ndash; an algebraic equation with a degree of one
* [[Quadratic equation]] &ndash; an algebraic equation with a degree of two
* [[Cubic equation]] &ndash; an algebraic equation with a degree of three
* [[Quartic equation]] &ndash; an algebraic equation with a degree of four
* [[Quintic equation]] &ndash; an algebraic equation with a degree of five
* [[Polynomial]] &ndash; an algebraic expression consisting of variables and coefficients
*[[Inequality (mathematics)|Inequalities]] – a comparison between values
*[[Function (mathematics)|Functions]] – mapping that associates a single output value with each input value
*[[Sequence]]s – ordered list of elements either finite or infinite
*[[System of equations|Systems of equations]] – finite set of equations
*[[Vector (mathematics and physics)|Vectors]] – element of a vector space
*[[Matrix (mathematics)|Matrix]] – two dimensional array of numbers
*[[Vector space]] – basic algebraic structure of linear algebra
*[[Field (mathematics)|Field]] – algebraic structure with addition, multiplication and division
*[[Group (mathematics)|Groups]] – algebraic structure with a single binary operation
*[[Ring (mathematics)|Rings]] – algebraic structure with addition and multiplication
